prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in Miami FL for a rental home?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” company for every Miami rental home, but **Novel Management** looks like a strong first company to interview for a long-term rental. It specifically manages single-family homes and offers leasing, tenant screening, rent collection, maintenance coordination, inspections, and owner reporting. Its published pricing starts at 5% monthly management, with leasing charged separately and no lease-renewal fee; ask for the full fee schedule for your property. [Novel Management](https://novelmanagement.com/)

I’d also compare **Atlis Property Management** and **JMK Property Management**. Atlis publishes a 5–9% management range, a leasing fee of 75% to one month’s rent, and says it doesn’t charge management fees while a home is vacant. JMK offers full-service residential management and publishes rates starting at 5%, with a one-month-rent placement fee. [Atlis](https://www.atlispm.com/miami-property-management) · [JMK](https://www.jmkpropertymanagement.com/pricing)

Before choosing, get written answers on the **total cost**—including leasing, renewals, inspections, maintenance markups, and cancellation terms—and ask for owner references for homes similar to yours. The best fit can depend a lot on the home’s neighborhood, rent, and whether you want long-term or short-term tenants.
